title: Perfect size
text: Perfect size. I received 24. 12 in separate boxes taped together. I plan to use then both for tree decorations and I'm putting together a wreath for my front door to feature the stars. They are rustic and very well finished. They even come with flexible wire loops for ease of hanging.

product_metadata.title: 24 Tin Barn Star Ornaments Christmas Tree Set Lot Primitive Country Rustic
description: Barn star ornaments. Fun tin details for your tree. You'll find many uses for these rustic metal stars, whether you scatter them on a tree as Christmas decorations or tie them to your gifts. Santa and homecoming friends will enjoy the heavenly touch these heavenly decorations bring to your decorations. Hang them from garlands or hang on the wall to enhance your Christmas decoration with star design. 3 3/4 inches.
